title: Tenant profile limits: per rule,, per organization
aliases: how many tenant profiles per rule

prose.text: There are three levels of cap: per rule, per profile, and per organization or across profiles.

prose.label: Per rule.
prose.text: {{per-rule-cap}} Do not confuse this with a different row: {{saas-tenants-not-profiles}}

prose.label: Per profile and across profiles, by application.
Two pages disagree.
prose.text: The Adding Tenant Profiles form states some counts differently from this table {{divergence:adding-vs-limits-page}}. How many identifiers of a type are already in use across profiles is open {{gap:live-count-vs-cap}}; the call that returns it is in [[zia.tenant-profiles.api-surface]].

The rule-level cap applies to the CAC rule, whose own count limits are in [[zia.cloud-app-control.rule-types]]. A Terraform provider older than 4.7.23 stopped lower; see [[zia.tenant-profiles.api-surface]].

checks.do: How many identifiers an application already has in use across profiles, checked before loading more.

per-rule-cap.statement: A Cloud App Control rule can have up to 16 tenant profiles associated with it.

quotes: Tenant Profiles per Rule | 16 tenant profiles | Each Cloud App Control Policy rule can have up to 16 tenant profiles associated with it.

saas-tenants-not-profiles.statement: The '16 tenants per SaaS application' limit sits in the SaaS Application Tenants section and concerns sanctioned SaaS application tenants; it is separate from the Tenant Profiles per Rule row under URL Filtering and Cloud App Control.

quotes: The following table shows the ranges and limitations for SaaS application tenants:
Up to 16 tenants can be added for each sanctioned SaaS application.

saas-tenants-not-profiles.conditions: Read from the section heading the row sits under; the row does not mention tenant profiles.

aws.statement: AWS: 256 account IDs, each 12 digits, and at most 2,048 across all profiles.

quotes: Amazon Web Services | 256 account IDs | Each account ID must have 12 digits. There can be a maximum of 2,048 account IDs across all profiles.

chatgpt.statement: ChatGPT: 128 workspace IDs, each up to 64 characters, and a rule can associate at most 16 tenant profiles or 20 workspace IDs.

quotes: ChatGPT | 128 workspace IDs | Each workspace ID can have up to 64 characters.You can associate a maximum of 16 tenant profiles or 20 workspace IDs per rule.

claude.statement: Claude: 16 workspace IDs, each up to 64 characters, and at most 64 workspace IDs per organization.

quotes: Claude | 16 workspace IDs | Each workspace ID can have up to 64 characters. There can be a maximum of 64 workspace IDs per organization.

docusign.statement: Docusign: 16 account IDs, each up to 64 characters, and at most 64 account IDs per organization.

quotes: Docusign | 16 account IDs | Each account ID can have up to 64 characters. There can be a maximum of 64 account IDs per organization.

dropbox.statement: Dropbox: 100 team IDs, each up to 64 characters.

quotes: Dropbox Team ID | 100 team IDs | Each team ID can have up to 64 characters.

github.statement: GitHub: one enterprise slug, up to 256 characters, at most 100 GitHub profiles per organization, and one GitHub profile per rule.

quotes: GitHub | One enterprise slug | Each enterprise slug can have up to 256 characters. There can be a maximum of 100 tenant profiles per organization.You can associate only one tenant profile per rule.

google-domains.statement: Google apps: 100 domains, each up to 160 characters, and at most 2,048 across all profiles.

quotes: Google App Domains | 100 domains | Each domain name can have up to 160 characters. There can be a maximum of 2,048 domains across all profiles.

gcp.statement: Google Cloud Platform: 100 organization IDs, each up to 64 characters, and at most 2,048 across all profiles.

quotes: Google Cloud Platform | 100 organization IDs | Each organization ID can have up to 64 characters. There can be a maximum of 2,048 organization IDs across all profiles.

ibm.statement: IBM SmartCloud: 100 account IDs, each up to 64 characters, at most 100 per rule and 256 across all profiles.

quotes: IBM SmartCloud | 100 account IDs | Each account ID can have up to 64 characters. There can be a maximum of 100 account IDs per rule and 256 account IDs across all profiles.

microsoft.statement: Microsoft Login Services: Version 1 takes one tenant directory (up to 64 characters) and up to 500 Microsoft 365 tenants or tenant IDs (each up to 64 characters). Version 2 takes one Tenant Directory ID:Policy ID value of up to 256 characters.

quotes: Microsoft Login Services (Version 1) Tenant Directory ID | One tenant directory | Each tenant directory can have up to 64 characters.
Microsoft Login Services (Version 2) Tenant Directory ID:Policy ID | One tenant directory:policy ID | Each tenant directory:policy ID can have up to 256 characters.
Microsoft Login Services (Version 1) Microsoft 365 Tenants or Tenant IDs | 500 Microsoft 365 tenants | Each Microsoft 365 tenant or tenant ID can have up to 64 characters.

slack.statement: Slack: 100 workspace IDs in Your Workspace ID and 256 in Allowed Workspace ID, each up to 64 characters.

quotes: Slack Your Workspace ID | 100 workspace IDs | Each workspace ID can have up to 64 characters.
Slack Allowed Workspace ID | 256 workspace IDs | Each workspace ID can have up to 64 characters.

youtube.statement: YouTube: 200 channel IDs (up to 100 characters each) and 100 school IDs (up to 127 characters each).

quotes: YouTube Channel ID | 200 channel IDs | Each channel ID can have up to 100 characters.
YouTube School ID | 100 school IDs | Each school ID can have up to 127 characters.

webex.statement: Webex: 100 tenants and at most 250 across all profiles.

quotes: Webex Login Services | 100 Webex tenants | There can be a maximum of 250 tenants across all profiles.

zoho.statement: Zoho: 120 Zoho IDs, each up to 127 characters, and at most 2,048 across all profiles.

quotes: Zoho Login Services | 120 Zoho IDs | Each Zoho ID can have up to 127 characters. There can be a maximum of 2,048 Zoho IDs across all profiles.

zoom.statement: Zoom: one policy label, up to 64 characters.

quotes: Zoom | One policy label | Each policy label can have up to 64 characters.

adding-vs-limits-page.summary: Per-profile identifier counts for AWS, ChatGPT and Zoho

quotes: You can add up to 512 account IDs.
You can add up to 128 IDs.

positions.says: The Adding Tenant Profiles form allows 512 AWS account IDs and 128 Zoho IDs.

quotes: You can add up to 16 workspace IDs per profile.
evidence.after: associated with the ChatGPT-Allowed-Workspace-Id header for ChatGPT

positions.says: The same form allows 16 ChatGPT workspace IDs.

quotes: Amazon Web Services | 256 account IDs |
Zoho Login Services | 120 Zoho IDs |

positions.says: The Ranges and Limitations table gives 256 AWS account IDs and 120 Zoho IDs.

quotes: ChatGPT | 128 workspace IDs |

positions.says: The same table gives 128 ChatGPT workspace IDs.

adding-vs-limits-page.impact: A bulk load sized to one page may be rejected or may succeed against the other. Check the live count with the app-item-count call before loading, and do not quote either number as the cap without saying which page it came from.

live-count-vs-cap.title: How many identifiers of a type are already in use across profiles
live-count-vs-cap.detail: The limits are, per rule and across all profiles. The count of items already in use for an application and item type is returned by the app-item-count call, with an optional profile excluded.
